RawMenuItem.description: One entry of the main menu.

icon.description: A Material Design Icons name, such as `home`; the page's own icon when absent.

title.description: The entry's text. Required for a full URL; a page's own title when absent.

url.description: A page's path, such as `/blog`, or a full URL.

RawSocialItem.description: A link to your profile on another site, shown as an icon on every page.

color.description: The icon's colour, in hex with or without `#`, such as `6364FF`. Required for a site vados doesn't recognise; it also overrides a recognised site's own colour.

icon.description: A Material Design Icons name. Required for a site vados doesn't recognise.

label.description: What screen readers announce for the link, which has no visible text. Required for a site vados doesn't recognise.

url.description: The profile's address. vados recognises GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X and Mastodon links by it.

description: The main menu and social links: `menu.json` in the root of the source tree.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can complete and check it. vados itself ignores it.

socials.description: Links to your profiles on other sites, in order.
